a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating up to 8 cells (at least 2 rounds) almost certainly leaves us both dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If you'd rather propose a different split, say so, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. I won't take more. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I'll keep operating until you have 4.
